raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

R3 requires the expert selections from every model layer, but vLLM currently rejects routed-expert capture with pipeline parallelism. Each PP stage captured only its own layers’ expert selections, so the final stage lacked the complete routing data required for R3. This PR enables PP > 1 R3 in MRV2.

## Claims

**Feature support**: Enable PP R3 by preserving expert selections from every PP stage.

## Validation

### Performance benchmark
Setup: `moonlight-16B-A3B-instruct` on B200; ISL/OSL=1024/512. Compare `enable-return-routed-experts` on and off.

| Metric | TP2 off | TP2 on | Δ TP | TP1/PP2 off | TP1/PP2 on | Δ PP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Throughput (tok/s) | 47,026 | 42,757 | −9.1% | 51,398 | 49,862 | −3.0% |
| Mean TTFT | 1,529.31 | 1,739.78 | +13.8% | 946.88 | 1,016.37 | +7.3% |
| Median TTFT | 1,509.67 | 1,712.91 | +13.5% | 942.09 | 1,003.21 | +6.5% |
| P99 TTFT | 2,903.84 | 3,354.01 | +15.5% | 1,703.44 | 1,855.23 | +8.9% |
| Mean TPOT | 9.29 | 10.39 | +11.8% | 9.50 | 9.74 | +2.5% |
| Median TPOT | 9.33 | 10.64 | +14.0% | 9.53 | 9.78 | +2.7% |
| P99 TPOT | 11.33 | 12.69 | +12.0% | 10.58 | 10.94 | +3.4% |
| Mean ITL | 9.48 | 10.84 | +14.3% | 9.51 | 10.20 | +7.3% |
| Median ITL | 7.50 | 8.24 | +9.8% | 8.45 | 8.51 | +0.7% |
| P99 ITL | 27.14 | 32.55 | +19.9% | 30.79 | 34.72 | +12.8% |

Collecting expert routes for replay adds overhead as expected, but the regression was lower for PP than TP.

**Server**
```bash
vllm serve --tensor-parallel-size 1 --pipeline-parallel-size 2 --distributed-executor-backend ray --enable-return-routed-experts
```

**Benchmark**
```bash
vllm bench serve --model=moonlight-bench --tokenizer=moonshotai/Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct --trust-remote-code --num-prompts=200 --request-rate=inf --ignore-eos --percentile-metrics=ttft,tpot,itl --metric-percentiles=50,99'
```

### Training run
See https://github.com/NovaSky-AI/SkyRL/pull/2471 for more details.

## Details

Each PP stage captures its own expert layers. We merge these snapshots and forward them alongside existing hidden-state transfers across PP stages. The final PP stage uses the existing async `AuxOutput` copy/store path.

This PR doesn't add new collectives and leaves TP-only capture unchanged.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+def test_first_pp_route_snapshot():

+def test_pp_route_shape_mismatch():
+    worker = object.__new__(AuxOutputWorkerConnector)
+    worker._capturer = SimpleNamespace(
+        device_buffer=torch.zeros((4, 3, 2), dtype=torch.int32)
+    )
+    batch = _input_batch(["request"], np.array([0]), np.array([0, 2]))
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="PP routed expert shapes must match"):

+
+
+def test_pp_routes_reach_request_outputs():
+    worker = _make_worker(2)
+    local = torch.zeros((8, *_SHAPE), dtype=torch.int32)
+    local[:, 2] = torch.arange(16).reshape(8, 2)
+    previous = torch.arange(30, dtype=torch.int32).reshape(5, *_SHAPE)
+    previous[:, 2] = 0
+    expected = (local[:5] + previous).numpy().astype(_DTYPE)
+    worker._capturer = Mock(device_buffer=local, output_dtype=torch.uint8)
+    worker.begin_step(
+        _metadata(
+            0,
+            [
+                _request_metadata("first", 0, 3, 0, []),
+                _request_metadata("second", 0, 2, 0, []),
+            ],
+            {},
+        ).metadata
+    )
+    batch = _input_batch(["first", "second"], np.array([0, 0]), np.array([0, 3, 5, 8]))
+
+    merged = worker.merge_pp_routed_experts(batch, previous)
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(local[:, :2]) == 0
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(previous[:, 2]) == 0
+    local.zero_()
+    previous.zero_()
+    pending = worker.prepare_output(batch, merged)
+    assert pending is not None
+    worker._capturer.snapshot_routing_data.assert_not_called()
+    assert pending.routed_experts_gpu.dtype == torch.uint8
+    pending.enqueue_cpu_copy(np.array([1, 1]), np.array([0, 0]))
+    outputs = worker.process_output(pending)
+
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(outputs["first"].rows, expected[:3])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(outputs["second"].rows, expected[3:])
+    worker.close()
+
+
